raw_segments.text: He strayed down a walk-edged with box, with apple trees, pear trees and cherry trees on
one side, and a border on the other full of all sorts of old-fashioned flowers, stalks,
sweet Williams, primroses, pansies, mingled with southern wood, sweet brier and various
They were fresh now as a succession of April showers and gleams, followed by a lovely spring
The sun was just entering the dappled east, and his light illumined the wreathed and dewy
orchard trees and shone down the quiet walks under them.
